description: Use when you need a signed observation of an existing Base USDC transfer. Verify a native Base USDC transfer by tx_hash (optional log_index), or exact pay_to + decimal amount + past start/end (max 90 days). Ambiguous matches fail without charge. Signed observation, OFAC flags, confirmations and printable HTML. Not invoice ownership or finality proof. Price $0.01 USDC on Base. No free trial. Price: 0.01 USDC. Minimal input example: {"tx_hash":"0x9ede68ce1d33fd5d49d402d11de3127710102235ac5bdf020344345dfeb8ce4f"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"result":{"kind":"payment_receipt","receipt":{"amount":"0.050000","time":"2026-10-22T22:07:07.000Z"}},"jws":"illustrative-not-a-live-signature"}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): No shared free trial for this tool. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

amount.description: Optional. Exact native Base USDC amount as a decimal string with at most six fractional digits. Example: "1.25" (1250000 atomic units). Required with pay_to, start and end when tx_hash is absent.

end.description: Optional. Exclusive past end timestamp string in ISO 8601 with timezone; UTC recommended. Example: 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Must be later than start and not in the future. Required in matching mode when tx_hash is absent.

log_index.description: Optional. Nonnegative transaction log index integer, at most 1000000. Example: 0. Optional only with tx_hash; use to disambiguate transfers.

pay_to.description: Optional. 0x-prefixed 20-byte recipient Base address string. Example: 0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58. Required with amount, start and end when tx_hash is absent.

start.description: Optional. Inclusive past start timestamp string in ISO 8601 with timezone; UTC recommended. Example: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Start/end window must be at most 90 days. Required in matching mode when tx_hash is absent.

tx_hash.description: Optional. 0x-prefixed 32-byte Base transaction hash string. Example format: 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Supply a real hash, optionally with log_index; otherwise supply pay_to, amount, start and end. Do not combine the two lookup modes.
